scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @price-intel/api" "npm run dev -w @price-intel/web"
scripts.dev:nodemon: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:nodemon -w @price-intel/api" "npm run dev -w @price-intel/web"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @price-intel/api" "npm run dev -w @price-intel/worker" "npm run dev -w @price-intel/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @price-intel/api && npm run build -w @price-intel/web
scripts.build:worker: npm run build -w @price-intel/api && npm run build -w @price-intel/worker
scripts.release:check: npm run db:validate && npm test && npm run build && npm run build -w @price-intel/worker
